$comment: Single source of truth for cross-language schema versions, CLI exit codes, diagnostic codes, and runtime codes shared by Rust, TypeScript (studio-ui), and Python (aicad).

cli_exit_codes.description: Command succeeded (or non-exact mesh preview inspection passed).
Compilation, geometry, topology, verification, or exact B-Rep watertightness check failed.
File I/O failure (E001_IO_ERROR), CLI argument/usage error, or project/host command error.

diagnostic_codes.description: Failed to read or access a source or asset file.
Lexical or syntactic parse error in KCL source.
Referenced identifier, function, or parameter is not defined.
Physical dimension or unit mismatch in an expression or feature argument.
Compile-time invalid literal or out-of-range numeric value.
Topological selector matched multiple entities without explicit disambiguation.
Topological selector matched zero entities.
Sketch profile is open where a closed loop is required.
Sketch region has open boundary or self-intersection.
2D geometric constraint system is overconstrained or conflicting.
Fillet radius or chamfer distance is non-positive, oversized, or degenerate.
Shell thickness is invalid for the target solid.
Feature operation parameters or geometry kernel operation failed.
Assembly component placement violates a mate constraint.
Thread specification or tap drill parameter is invalid.
Resulting B-Rep or mesh has open edges or fails manifold watertightness.
Resulting solid has zero or degenerate volume.
Bounding-box assertion failed.
Manufacturability check detected inaccessible or non-machinable geometry.
Caller supplied an invalid or missing argument.
Semantic command payload or catalog operation was rejected.
Agent output or contract payload failed schema validation.
Artifact export (STEP, DXF, 3MF, SVG, mesh, or render) failed.
Strict GraphEvaluator mode rejected a source containing constructs that still require the legacy DSL evaluator.
Referenced graph node or parameter id does not exist.
Main branch revision moved past preview base revision.
Optimistic concurrency revision check failed.
Inspected exact B-Rep asset is not a watertight solid.
Command batch parsed but failed graph or domain validation rules.
In-memory runtime session diverged from persisted SQLite head.
External asset path does not exist in workspace sandbox.
Asset path escaped workspace sandbox or used forbidden syntax/symlink.
External asset SHA-256 digest does not match declared sha256.
External asset format is unsupported or requires an unavailable kernel backend.
Imported geometry has open boundaries or non-manifold edges/vertices.
Solids overlap or violate minimum clearance threshold.
Unsupported boolean combination across discrete mesh and exact B-Rep representations.
A preview or document branch with the requested name already exists.
Operation was cancelled before commit.
SQLite container read or write operation failed.
Runtime discovery file could not be written or parsed.
Graph evaluation failed before a durable result was recorded.
Requested operator is experimental and cannot be delivered as exact B-Rep.
Requested feature requires a compile-time Cargo feature that is disabled.
Fillet, chamfer, shell, or boolean operation produced degenerate geometry.
Filesystem I/O error outside the path sandbox.
Malformed JSON-RPC request payload received by the MCP gateway.
KCL source could not be parsed or projected to the canonical graph.
Redo stack is empty for the active branch.
Active branch has no oplog entry available to undo.
Requested path escapes workspace_root or contains a forbidden parent traversal segment.
Protected branch (such as main or the active branch) cannot be deleted or overwritten.
Unspecified runtime session or host failure.
Unclassified CLI error.
Referenced branch name does not exist in the container.

runtime_codes.description: GPU compute/render path fell back to CPU implementation.
Inter-process communication with daemon or desktop bridge failed.
Native OCCT geometry kernel fault or availability status.
Implicit field evaluation produced an empty isosurface.
Visual critic / VLM evaluation degraded or unavailable.
Client reconnected to persistent CAD daemon.
